facts.claim: Lucerne sits on Lake Lucerne and the Reuss, with a compact old town.
facts.sourceLocation: This is Lucerne; Chapel Bridge and Old Town.

facts.claim: Weinmarkt and Kornmarkt with the town hall are historic old-town squares; painted facades are characteristic.
facts.sourceLocation: Chapel Bridge and Old Town: historic places such as the wine market or the Kornmarkt with the town hall; painted façades.

facts.claim: The KKL is beside the railway station; Inseli park and the waterfront promenade provide lakeside walks.
facts.sourceLocation: Lucerne and Lake Lucerne: Start your tour around the lake at the unique KKL next to the train station; Inseli park; wide waterfront promenade opposite.

facts.claim: Boat excursions connect the lake experience with Vitznau/Rigi and Alpnachstad/Pilatus.
facts.sourceLocation: Around Lucerne: Vitznau with the Rigi or Alpnachstad with the Pilatus.
